answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity to a remotely verified enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and a hardware-rooted platform key: MRENCLAVE proves which code runs, while the key proves possession of an attested machine. Duplicating a virtual machine cannot forge that proof, so cloning identities at scale requires access to physical silicon rather than VM duplication. Labels such as saffron, lagoon, or relic add no authority without valid attestation.
